title: Rooftop Jazz in Two Formats
tests: Checks delivery of two correctly composed aspect-ratio variants with matching event content, readable overlays and no letterboxing.

faults.what: The portrait ensemble shots crop away the left-side musician's head while retaining his playing hand and instrument, and the right-side musician's head is clipped at the frame edge around 3.8 seconds. This fails the explicit requirement to avoid cropped-off musicians' faces.

judge.summary: Both formats deliver matching sunset rooftop performances with clear, correct event text, but the portrait ensemble framing needs adjustment to avoid cutting off musicians.

must_haves.item: Two separate playable videos are delivered, each 10 seconds long: one 9:16 and one 16:9.
must_haves.why: Two separately named video outputs are shown in the requested aspect ratios, and both are reported as 10 seconds long.

must_haves.item: Both versions show rooftop musicians at sunset with consistent styling and event content.
must_haves.why: Both use matching golden sunset rooftop footage, black-clad musicians, and identical event information.

must_haves.item: Both versions display exactly 'Rooftop Jazz', '18 July 2026' and 'Sky Terrace, Manchester'.
must_haves.why: All three strings are spelled correctly in both versions.

must_haves.item: All three text lines are fully inside each frame and readable together for at least 3 seconds.
must_haves.why: All three lines are fully contained and clearly readable together in every supplied sample, spanning 1.3 to 8.8 seconds in both versions.

must_haves.item: Both compositions fill their frames without black bars, stretched imagery or cropped-off musicians' faces.
must_haves.why: The imagery fills both formats without visible bars or stretching, but the portrait ensemble crop excludes one musician's head and clips another at the right edge.

must_haves.item: Both videos contain mellow jazz and no voiceover.
must_haves.why: The sound reports indicate no clear speech in either video, but they do not establish whether the music is mellow jazz.
